footguns: UNRELIABLE TEST(S) - the probe could not produce a trustworthy result for some identity/command, so the suite fails loudly here rather than asserting a possibly-wrong outcome. Each finding below names its cause and a `Fix:` for how to get ahead of it: SELECT: service_role [probe observed count=2]: probing as 'service_role' bypasses RLS: the role carries BYPASSRLS, so it sees every row regardless of policy -- a passing observation here cannot distinguish a correct policy from a broken one. Fix: ALTER ROLE service_role NOBYPASSRLS so the policy actually applies (or, if the bypass is intentional, do not probe it as a constrained user -- it is a sanctioned bypass, reported separately as the L014 finding)

the 'anon, anonymous-(unauthenticated)' row is the Postgres role service_role -- this schema has no 'anon' role, so service_role (its discovered unauthenticated client role) stands in as the anonymous identity.
